summary: The submission is a single document that provides an inventory (Task 1) of 28 papers on AI applications in energy‑intensive industrial production, including metadata extraction and domain boundary definition, and a thematic/topographical mapping (Task 2) that organizes the papers into six clusters with detailed method descriptions. The work stops at the mapping stage and does not include synthesis, integrative synthesis, or a final report.
issues: Only Tasks 1 and 2 are present; later required tasks are missing.
No explicit declaration of AI tool usage by the student.
Bibliographic details are embedded but a separate bibliography section is absent.
